records.claim: Losartan has not been studied in humans for use during breastfeeding. Information from animal studies suggest that losartan passes into milk and could affect the kidneys of the nursing baby. The product label for losartan recommends women who are breastfeeding not use this medication. But the benefit of using losartan may outweigh possible risks. Your healthcare providers can talk with you about using losartan and what treatment is best for you. Be sure to talk to your healthcare provider about all your breastfeeding questions.
